```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
#remotes::install_github("forrtproject/FReD")
library(FReD)
library(glue)

source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forrtproject/FReD-data/refs/heads/main/clean_cos_fred.R")

fred_validated_full <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv", skip = 1)

# filter for validated - chosen entries
fred_validated_raw <- fred_validated_full[fred_validated_full$status == "validated - chosen", ]

```

```{r}
cleaned <- clean_fred_data(fred_validated_raw)
fred_validated <- cleaned$cleaned_data
```

```{r}
#' Generate a GitHub Issue Report for FReD Data Validation
#'
#' @param data A dataframe containing the data to be validated.
#' @param tests_to_run A numeric vector specifying which tests to run.
#'   If NULL (default), all tests are run.
#' @return A character string containing the Markdown-formatted report.
validate_fred_data <- function(data, tests_to_run = NULL) {

  # --- Configuration ---
  VALID_ES_TYPES <- c(
    #Standard
    c("b (unstd)", "beta (std)", "cohen's", "h", "cramer's", "V", "d", "etasq", "cohen's", "f", "hedges'", "g", "OR", "r", "r-squared", "test", "statistic", "kendall's", "w", "etasq (partial)"),
    #Tolerated
    c("partial r", "phi")
  )
  VALID_PVAL_TYPES <- c("e (=)", "l (<)", "g (>)", "le (<=)", "ge (>=)", NA)
  VALID_NESTED <- c("yes", "no", NA) # Added NA as valid
  URL_COLS <- c("url_r", "link_o", "link_r", "prereg_o", "prereg_r")
  # This regex validates statistical test statistic strings.
# It ensures the string starts (^) and ends ($) with a valid format.
#
# It accepts two main types of formats, separated by '|':
#
# 1. For F, t, or X2 (Chi-squared) statistics:
#    - `F|t|X2`: Matches the statistic type.
#    - `\\(`...`\\)`: Encloses degrees of freedom.
#    - `\\d+(\\.\\d+)?`: Matches one or more digits, optionally followed by a decimal and more digits,
#      allowing for continuous degrees of freedom.
#    - ` ?`: Allows for optional spaces (e.g., after comma in F(df1, df2)).
#    - ` ?= ?`: Matches the equals sign with optional spaces around it.
#    - `[\\-–\\+]?`: Matches an optional plus, minus, or en-dash sign for the value.
#    - `(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)`: Matches the numeric test statistic value, allowing
#      for decimals (e.g., 1.23, .5) or scientific notation (e.g., 1e-5, 2.3E+2).
#
# 2. For the Z statistic:
#    - `Z`: Matches the literal "Z".
#    - ` ?= ?`: Matches the equals sign with optional spaces.
#    - `[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)`: Matches the numeric Z-score value (same as above).
#    - `, ?N ?= ?`: Requires a comma, optional spaces, "N", optional spaces, "=", optional spaces.
#    - `\\d+(\\.\\d+)?`: Matches the 'N' value (sample size), allowing for both integers and decimals.
#      The 'N' value is mandatory for Z-statistics in this format.
TEST_STAT_REGEX <- "^((F\\(\\d+(\\.\\d+)?, ?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\)|t\\(\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\)|X2\\(\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\)) ?[=<>≤] ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)|Z ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?) ?, ?N ?= ?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?)$"

  NUMERIC_REGEX <- "^-?\\d*\\.?\\d+([eE][-+]?\\d+)?$"
  ID_THRESHOLD <- 5

  # --- Storage for report items ---
  issues_by_id <- list()
  all_checks <- list()
  # --- New storage for the failure dataframe ---
  failures_df <- data.frame(test_failure = character(), fred_id = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # --- Helper to check if a test should run ---
  should_run <- function(test_number) {
    is.null(tests_to_run) || (test_number %in% tests_to_run)
  }

  # --- Helper Functions ---
  format_id_list <- function(ids){
    if(length(ids) == 0) return("")
    if(length(ids) > ID_THRESHOLD){
      return(glue("<details><summary>{length(ids)} issues found</summary>`{paste(ids, collapse=', ')}`</details>"))
    } else {
      return(glue("`{paste(ids, collapse=', ')}`"))
    }
  }

  add_to_id_report <- function(issue_list, issue_df, message_template, ...){
    cols_for_message <- list(...)
    
    if (length(cols_for_message) == 0) {
        ids <- unique(issue_df$id)
        for(id_val in ids){
            issue_list[[as.character(id_val)]] <- c(issue_list[[as.character(id_val)]], message_template)
        }
        return(issue_list)
    }
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(issue_df)){
      id_val <- issue_df$id[i]
      glue_args <- lapply(cols_for_message, function(col_name) issue_df[[col_name]][i])
      message <- do.call(glue, c(list(message_template), glue_args))
      issue_list[[as.character(id_val)]] <- c(issue_list[[as.character(id_val)]], message)
    }
    return(issue_list)
  }
  
  add_main_report_item <- function(issue_df, message_template, check_name) {
      if(nrow(issue_df) > 0) {
          ids <- unique(issue_df$id)
          all_checks[[check_name]] <<- list(status = "fail", msg = glue(message_template, id_list = format_id_list(ids)))
          
          # --- Populate the failures dataframe ---
          new_failures <- data.frame(
            test_failure = rep(check_name, nrow(issue_df)),
            fred_id = as.character(issue_df$id),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
          failures_df <<- bind_rows(failures_df, new_failures)

      } else {
          all_checks[[check_name]] <<- list(status = "pass", msg = check_name)
      }
  }

  # --- Validation Checks ---
  
  if(should_run(1)){
    string_na_issues <- data %>%
      select(id, where(is.character)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -id, names_to = "column", values_to = "value", values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
      filter(value %in% c("NA", "N/A"))
    add_main_report_item(string_na_issues, "Contains string literals 'NA' or 'N/A'. Check id(s): {id_list}", "No 'NA'/'N/A' strings")
    if(nrow(string_na_issues) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, string_na_issues, "Column `{column}` contains a forbidden string: '{value}'.", column="column", value="value")
    }
  }
  
  if(should_run(2)){
    doi_in_ref_issues <- data %>% filter(str_detect(ref_o, "doi:|10\\.") | str_detect(ref_r, "doi:|10\\."))
    add_main_report_item(doi_in_ref_issues, "DOI found in `ref_o` or `ref_r`. Check id(s): {id_list}", "No DOIs in reference columns")
    if(nrow(doi_in_ref_issues) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, doi_in_ref_issues, "DOI found in `ref_o` or `ref_r`.")
    }
  }

  if(should_run(3)){
    doi_format_issues <- data %>% filter((!is.na(doi_o) & !str_starts(doi_o, "10."))  | (!is.na(doi_r) & !str_starts(doi_r, "10.")))
    add_main_report_item(doi_format_issues, "`doi_o` or `doi_r` has incorrect format. Check id(s): {id_list}", "DOI columns start with '10.'")
    if(nrow(doi_format_issues) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, doi_format_issues, "`doi_o` or `doi_r` has incorrect format (must start with '10.').")
    }
  }
  
  if(should_run(4)){
    url_issues <- data %>% select(id, all_of(URL_COLS)) %>% pivot_longer(-id, names_to="column", values_to="value", values_drop_na=TRUE) %>% filter(!str_starts(value, "http"))
    add_main_report_item(url_issues, "URL columns contain values that are not full URLs. Check id(s): {id_list}", "All links are valid URLs")
    if(nrow(url_issues) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, url_issues, "Column `{column}` contains a value that is not a full URL: '{value}'.", column="column", value="value")
    }
  }
  
  if(should_run(5)){
    numeric_cols_check <- c("n_o", "n_r", "pval_value_o", "pval_value_r")
    non_numeric_issues <- data %>%
      select(id, all_of(numeric_cols_check)) %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -id, names_to = "column", values_to = "value", values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(value, NUMERIC_REGEX))
    add_main_report_item(non_numeric_issues, "Non-numeric text found in numeric columns. Check id(s): {id_list}", "All values in numeric columns are numeric")
    if(nrow(non_numeric_issues) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, non_numeric_issues, "Column `{column}` contains a non-numeric value: '{value}'.", column="column", value="value")
    }
  }

  if(should_run(6)){
    es_non_numeric <- data %>% mutate(across(c(es_value_o, es_value_r), as.character)) %>%
      filter((es_type_o != "test statistic" & !is.na(es_value_o) & !str_detect(es_value_o, NUMERIC_REGEX)) |
               (es_type_r != "test statistic" & !is.na(es_value_r) & !str_detect(es_value_r, NUMERIC_REGEX)))
    add_main_report_item(es_non_numeric, "`es_value` is not numeric for a standard effect size type. Check id(s): {id_list}", "Effect size values are numeric")
    if(nrow(es_non_numeric) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, es_non_numeric, "`es_value` is not numeric for its standard `es_type`.")
    }
  }
  
  if(should_run(7)){
    # Check original value
    test_stat_issues_o <- data %>% filter((es_type_o == "test statistic" & !is.na(es_value_o) & !str_detect(es_value_o, TEST_STAT_REGEX)))
    add_main_report_item(test_stat_issues_o, "`es_value_o` for 'test statistic' has incorrect format. Check id(s): {id_list}", "Original test statistic format is valid")
    if(nrow(test_stat_issues_o) > 0) {
       issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, test_stat_issues_o, "`es_value_o` ('{es_value_o}') for 'test statistic' has incorrect format.", es_value_o = "es_value_o")
    }
    
    # Check replication value
    test_stat_issues_r <- data %>% filter((es_type_r == "test statistic" & !is.na(es_value_r) & !str_detect(es_value_r, TEST_STAT_REGEX)))
    add_main_report_item(test_stat_issues_r, "`es_value_r` for 'test statistic' has incorrect format. Check id(s): {id_list}", "Replication test statistic format is valid")
    if(nrow(test_stat_issues_r) > 0) {
       issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, test_stat_issues_r, "`es_value_r` ('{es_value_r}') for 'test statistic' has incorrect format.", es_value_r = "es_value_r")
    }
  }
  
  if(should_run(8)){
    es_type_blank_issues <- data %>% filter((is.na(es_type_o) & !is.na(es_value_o)) | (is.na(es_type_r) & !is.na(es_value_r)))
    add_main_report_item(es_type_blank_issues, "`es_type` is blank but `es_value` is not. Check id(s): {id_list}", "No blank `es_type` with existing `es_value`")
    if(nrow(es_type_blank_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, es_type_blank_issues, "`es_type` is blank but `es_value` is not.")

    es_type_invalid_issues <- data %>% filter(!es_type_o %in% VALID_ES_TYPES | !es_type_r %in% VALID_ES_TYPES)
    add_main_report_item(es_type_invalid_issues, "`es_type` contains a value not in the approved list. Check id(s): {id_list}", "`es_type` values are valid")
    if(nrow(es_type_invalid_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, es_type_invalid_issues, "`es_type` is not in the list of valid types.")
  }

  if(should_run(9)){
    pval_range_issues <- data %>% 
      mutate(across(c(pval_value_o, pval_value_r), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
      filter((!is.na(pval_value_o) & (pval_value_o < 0 | pval_value_o > 1)) | (!is.na(pval_value_r) & (pval_value_r < 0 | pval_value_r > 1)))
    add_main_report_item(pval_range_issues, "`pval_value` is outside the valid 0-1 range. Check id(s): {id_list}", "`pval_value` is within 0-1 range")
    if(nrow(pval_range_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, pval_range_issues, "`pval_value` is outside the valid 0-1 range.")
  }
  
  if(should_run(10)){
    pval_type_issues <- data %>% filter(!pval_type_o %in% VALID_PVAL_TYPES | !pval_type_r %in% VALID_PVAL_TYPES)
    add_main_report_item(pval_type_issues, "`pval_type` contains invalid values. Check id(s): {id_list}", "`pval_type` values are valid")
    
    pval_tails_issues <- data %>% mutate(across(c(pval_tails_o, pval_tails_r), as.numeric)) %>% filter(!pval_tails_o %in% c(1,2,NA) | !pval_tails_r %in% c(1,2,NA))
    add_main_report_item(pval_tails_issues, "`pval_tails` values are invalid. Check id(s): {id_list}", "`pval_tails` values are valid")

    nested_issues <- data %>% filter(!nested_o %in% VALID_NESTED | !nested_r %in% VALID_NESTED)
    add_main_report_item(nested_issues, "`nested` column contains invalid values. Check id(s): {id_list}", "`nested` values are valid")
  }
  
  if(should_run(11)){
    data_numeric_es <- data %>% mutate(across(c(es_value_o, es_value_r), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))))
    corr_issues <- data_numeric_es %>% filter(es_type_o %in% c("r", "partial r", "phi") & abs(es_value_o) > 1)
    add_main_report_item(corr_issues, "Correlation `es_value_o` outside -1 to 1 range. Check id(s): {id_list}", "Correlation values are within range")
    if(nrow(corr_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, corr_issues, "Correlation `es_value_o` ('{es_value_o}') is outside the -1 to 1 range.", es_value_o="es_value_o")

    rsq_issues <- data_numeric_es %>% filter(es_type_o == "r-squared" & (es_value_o < 0 | es_value_o > 1))
    add_main_report_item(rsq_issues, "r-squared `es_value_o` outside 0 to 1 range. Check id(s): {id_list}", "r-squared values are within range")
    if(nrow(rsq_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, rsq_issues, "r-squared `es_value_o` ('{es_value_o}') is outside the 0 to 1 range.", es_value_o="es_value_o")
    
    or_issues <- data_numeric_es %>% filter(es_type_o == "OR" & es_value_o < 0)
    add_main_report_item(or_issues, "Odds Ratio `es_value_o` is negative. Check id(s): {id_list}", "Odds Ratio values are not negative")
    if(nrow(or_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, or_issues, "Odds Ratio `es_value_o` ('{es_value_o}') is negative.", es_value_o="es_value_o")
  }

  if(should_run(12)){
    prereg_issues <- data %>% filter(str_detect(prereg_o, "osf\\.io") & !str_detect(prereg_o, "/registrations/"))
    add_main_report_item(prereg_issues, "OSF preregistration link may point to a project. Check id(s): {id_list}", "OSF preregistration links seem valid")
    if(nrow(prereg_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, prereg_issues, "OSF preregistration link ('{prereg_o}') may point to a project, not a registration.", prereg_o="prereg_o")
  }
  
  if(should_run(13)){
    ref_inc_issues <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(ref_o) & str_ends(ref_o, "\\d")) %>%
      mutate(ref_base = str_remove(ref_o, "\\d+$")) %>%
      group_by(ref_base) %>%
      filter(n_distinct(ref_o) > 1) %>%
      ungroup()
    add_main_report_item(ref_inc_issues, "Reference string may be a spreadsheet error (e.g. Refa1, Refa2). Check id(s): {id_list}", "No likely reference incrementing errors")
    if(nrow(ref_inc_issues) > 0) {
        issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, ref_inc_issues, "Reference string ('{ref_o}') is part of a set that only differs by the final number.", ref_o="ref_o")
    }
  }
  
  if(should_run(14)){
    data_numeric_es <- data %>% mutate(across(c(es_value_o, es_value_r), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))))
    large_d_issues <- data_numeric_es %>% filter(es_type_o == 'd' & abs(es_value_o) > 3)
    add_main_report_item(large_d_issues, "Cohen's d (`es_value_o`) is unusually large (>3). Check id(s): {id_list}", "No unusually large Cohen's d values")
    if(nrow(large_d_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, large_d_issues, "Cohen's d `es_value_o` ('{es_value_o}') is unusually large (>3).", es_value_o="es_value_o")
    
    large_or_issues <- data_numeric_es %>% filter(es_type_o == 'OR' & (es_value_o > 20 | es_value_o < 0.05))
    add_main_report_item(large_or_issues, "Odds Ratio (`es_value_o`) is unusually large/small. Check id(s): {id_list}", "No unusually large/small Odds Ratio values")
    if(nrow(large_or_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, large_or_issues, "Odds Ratio `es_value_o` ('{es_value_o}') is unusually large (>20) or small (<0.05).", es_value_o="es_value_o")
  }
  
  if(should_run(15)){
    data_numeric_es <- data %>% mutate(across(c(es_value_o, es_value_r), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))))
    reversal_issues <- data_numeric_es %>%
      filter( pval_value_r < 0.05,
        (es_type_r %in% c("r", "d") & sign(es_value_o) != sign(es_value_r) & !is.na(es_value_o) & !is.na(es_value_r)) |
        (es_type_r == "OR" & ((es_value_o > 1 & es_value_r < 1) | (es_value_o < 1 & es_value_r > 1)) & !is.na(es_value_o) & !is.na(es_value_r))
      )
    add_main_report_item(reversal_issues, "Potential significant reversal of effect direction detected. Check id(s): {id_list}", "No significant reversals of effect direction")
    if(nrow(reversal_issues) > 0) issues_by_id <- add_to_id_report(issues_by_id, reversal_issues, "Potential significant reversal of effect direction detected (O: {es_value_o}, R: {es_value_r}).", es_value_o="es_value_o", es_value_r="es_value_r")
  }

  # --- Build Report String ---
  report_parts <- c()
  report_parts <- c(report_parts, "## FReD Data Validation Report\n")
  report_parts <- c(report_parts, glue("Report generated on: {format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n"))
  
  error_items <- all_checks[sapply(all_checks, function(x) x$status == "fail")]
  pass_items <- all_checks[sapply(all_checks, function(x) x$status == "pass")]

  if (length(error_items) > 0) {
    report_parts <- c(report_parts, "### ❌ ERRORS & FLAGS (must be reviewed)")
    error_msgs <- sapply(error_items, function(item) paste0("- [ ] ", item$msg))
    report_parts <- c(report_parts, error_msgs, "")
  }
  
  if (length(pass_items) > 0) {
    pass_msgs <- sapply(pass_items, function(item) paste0("- [x] ", item$msg))
    report_parts <- c(report_parts, pass_msgs, "")
  }

  if (length(issues_by_id) > 0) {
    report_parts <- c(report_parts, "<details>\n<summary><strong>Actionable Issues Organized by ID</strong></summary>\n")
    sorted_ids <- sort(names(issues_by_id))
    for(id_val in sorted_ids){
      report_parts <- c(report_parts, glue("#### ID: `{id_val}`"))
      for(issue in unique(issues_by_id[[id_val]])){
          report_parts <- c(report_parts, paste0("- ", issue))
      }
      report_parts <- c(report_parts, "")
    }
    report_parts <- c(report_parts, "</details>")
  }

  # --- Finalize return object ---
  final_report_string <- paste(report_parts, collapse = "\n")
  
  return(list(
    report = final_report_string, 
    df = distinct(failures_df)
  ))
}




# --- Run the validation ---
validation_report <- validate_fred_data(cleaned$cleaned_data, tests_to_run = c(5, 7, 9, 10))
validation_report$report %>% clipr::write_clip()

```
